title: Quality-Time vs Screen-Time Split
dataSources: Relationship check-ins (`relationship:checkin`), date nights (`datenight:log`), gift ideas (`giftidea:item`), keep-in-touch contacts (`keptintouch:contact`).
app: Relationship and togetherness logs — shared check-in apps, date-night and gift-idea lists, and stay-in-touch reminders — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal (sourcetype=datenight:log OR sourcetype=screentime:usage)
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(eval(if(sourcetype=="datenight:log",duration_min,0))) as together, sum(eval(if(sourcetype=="screentime:usage",minutes,0))) as screen by _time
| eval ratio=round(together/(screen+1),3)
description: Contrasts the time spent together against time on screens each week, a gentle mirror on where attention goes.
value: Putting togetherness and screen minutes side by side can prompt small, deliberate changes toward presence.
implementation: Join together-time with screen-time in `index=personal`; trend the ratio weekly.
visualization: Dual-axis chart of together-time versus screen-time per week.
grandmaExplanation: It compares time spent together with time on screens each week, a gentle nudge toward being more present.
